policy: ADR-0007 D3 amendment (2026-09-25): a Sigma attack.sNNNN (software) tag becomes evidence only if this review accepts it for that rule; accepted only when every branch of the rule's detection logic identifies that specific tool. Unreviewed or rejected software tags are recorded and ignored, like Group tags. Technique tags are unaffected.

decisions.title: HackTool - CrackMapExec Execution Patterns
decisions.reason: Some branches match powershell.exe command lines, not cmd; the rule identifies CrackMapExec patterns, not the cmd tool.

decisions.title: PSEXEC Remote Execution File Artefact
decisions.reason: C:\Windows\PSEXEC-*.key is an artefact written by Sysinternals PsExec itself.

decisions.title: PUA - NirCmd Execution
decisions.reason: Detects NirCmd (image/OriginalFileName NirCmd.exe or its command verbs), a different tool from PsExec.

decisions.title: Potential Persistence Via Netsh Helper DLL
decisions.reason: Every branch requires netsh.exe (image or OriginalFileName).

decisions.title: HackTool - Default PowerSploit/Empire Scheduled Task Creation
decisions.reason: Requires schtasks.exe as the process image.

decisions.title: Firewall Disabled via Netsh.EXE
decisions.reason: Every branch requires netsh.exe (image or OriginalFileName).

decisions.title: HackTool - Windows Credential Editor (WCE) Execution
decisions.reason: Branches are WCE.exe/WCE64.exe images or WCE import hashes; both identify WCE (the hash branch is not translatable today and is dropped by the importer).

decisions.title: Esentutl Gather Credentials
decisions.reason: Requires the esentutl invocation in the command line.

decisions.title: RemCom Service File Creation
decisions.reason: RemComSvc.exe belongs to RemCom, an open-source PsExec alternative, not PsExec.

decisions.title: PUA - RunXCmd Execution
decisions.reason: Detects RunXCmd command-line flags, a different tool from PsExec.

decisions.title: Suspicious Download From Direct IP Via Bitsadmin
decisions.reason: Requires bitsadmin.exe (image or OriginalFileName).

decisions.title: LSASS Memory Access by Tool With Dump Keyword In Name
decisions.reason: Matches any source image containing 'dump' (e.g. Outflank-Dumpert.exe in the OTRF sample); does not identify Mimikatz.

decisions.title: Renamed Remote Utilities RAT (RURAT) Execution
decisions.reason: Requires PE Product 'Remote Utilities', i.e. the Remote Utilities binary itself (renamed).

decisions.title: Windows Credential Editor Registry
decisions.reason: The WCESERVICE service key is created by WCE itself.

decisions.title: Remote LSASS Process Access Through Windows Remote Management
decisions.reason: Any tool run over WinRM (wsmprovhost.exe) reading LSASS matches; Mimikatz is one possibility, not identified.

decisions.title: File Download Via Bitsadmin
decisions.reason: Requires bitsadmin.exe (image or OriginalFileName).

decisions.title: PUA - NirCmd Execution As LOCAL SYSTEM
decisions.reason: Detects NirCmd's 'runassystem' verb, a different tool from PsExec.

decisions.title: Credential Dumping Attempt Via WerFault
decisions.reason: Detects WerFault.exe opening LSASS with full access; does not identify Mimikatz.

decisions.title: Copying Sensitive Files with Credential Data
decisions.reason: Condition is 'all of selection_esent_* or selection_susp_paths': the sensitive-path branch fires without esentutl.

decisions.title: CSExec Service File Creation
decisions.reason: csexecsvc.exe belongs to CSExec, a C# PsExec alternative, not PsExec.

decisions.title: HackTool - Htran/NATBypass Execution
decisions.reason: Also matches lcx.exe and the -tran/-slave syntax shared by other port-forwarders; HTRAN is not uniquely identified.

decisions.title: Credential Dumping Activity By Python Based Tool
decisions.reason: Any Python tool reading LSASS via ctypes matches (e.g. pypykatz); LaZagne is not identified.
